title: fix(react-router): search was triggered too many times
body:
* add deepEqual instead of shallowEqual comparaison when dealing with new widgets props.
* also compare at react-router example level if the App should update because of a `render` that is triggered even if the `onSearchStateChange`.

Also I'm not sure if we need yet the check for equality when passing new props to `<InstantSearch/>` so I didn't included it in this PR.
